about.title: Engineering High-Performance Web Systems with Pixel-Perfect Precision
about.lead: I am a multidisciplinary Full Stack Developer & UI Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience bridging elegant interface aesthetics with scalable, rock-solid backend infrastructure.

pillars.title: Full Stack Developer & UI Engineer
pillars.content: I specialize in architecting responsive web applications, zero-dependency design systems, and robust backend services. My work focuses on sub-second render performance, seamless user experiences, and rigorous type safety.

pillars.title: From Core Fundamentals to Enterprise Cloud
pillars.content: Starting with fundamental computer science principles, algorithms, and relational data structures, I evolved into building distributed microservices, scalable REST APIs, and production Next.js frontends supporting heavy concurrent traffic.

pillars.title: Proven Production Delivery
pillars.content: Engineered web platforms handling 100K+ monthly active users with sub-second page loads, reduced client-side bundle sizes by 40%, and standardized accessible design tokens across fast-paced development cycles.

pillars.title: 60fps Motion & Accessible Architecture
pillars.content: I believe engineering excellence lives at the intersection of fluid 60fps kinematics, strict WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, comprehensive test coverage with Jest, and resilient cloud architectures.
